text:
morgan_sales: Quick presales ask — prospect wants a 10-day POC completely inside AWS Wavelength (us-east-1-wl2). Requirements: (1) inference traffic and KMS calls must stay in-zone, (2) they want BYO-KMS via VPC endpoint, (3) they asked for a short subprocessor manifest limited to Redwood services and a carrier attestation. Can we support this for a POC and what do we need from them?
ops_oncall: Short: compute in wl2 via Dedicated/Private = yes; hosted control plane in wl2 = no. For POC we can deploy runtime in wl2 and either (A) accept limited control-plane egress, or (B) deploy a lightweight control-plane proxy inside their VPC to avoid egress (adds ~3 business days). Need ENI/peering details + KMS vpce info.
eng_infra: Technical: confirm instance SKU and MTU; WL SKUs vary in throughput. BYO-KMS works if they expose a VPC endpoint and give cross-account decrypt permissions to our runtime principal. We'll also disable KV prefix caching by default to avoid cross-zone egress.
legal_ana: We can provide a Redwood-only subprocessor manifest. Carrier/ISP subprocessors are third parties; we can draft an attestation template the customer can send to the carrier but cannot force their signature. If the customer requires contractual "carrier-only" guarantees, that's a DPA appendix and a legal exception we must sign off on.
sre_luca: Ops snippet you can share (strict zone policy). Note caveat: strict = reject-on-no-capacity.

```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: "zone-strict"
  preferred_zone: "us-east-1-wl2"
  fallback: []
  byo_kms: true
  kms_vpc_endpoint: "vpce-<customer>"
  telemetry: "minimal"
  kv_cache: "disabled"
  enforcement: "reject-on-no-capacity"
```

sre_luca: Include these asks with the snippet: 1) carrier legal entity + peering contact, 2) ENI and WL subnet CIDR, 3) BYO-KMS ARN + vpce DNS + cross-account policy, 4) expected QPS/concurrency/avg seq length, 5) confirmation they accept request rejection if wl2 is saturated.
deploy-bot: Ticket PR-12345 opened for wl2 proxy feasibility (ETA 72h).
morgan_sales: I'll gather the carrier PoA (they listed "HarborCell Mobile Inc."), ENI docs, and the KMS vpce info and circle back. Thanks all :pray:
